description:
REVIEWED 2026-10-25 (TodoReview) against origin/develop 9a184b619 and fork main ea44bcc9 (30.24.0.13). PROBLEM
`_prettify_sql` in scripts/generate_query_docs.py (also used by scripts/export_docs_data.py) calls `benchbox._vendor.sqlglot.transpile(sql, read=read, write=read, pretty=True)` for documentation formatting. It bypasses `translate_sql_query`, and tests/unit/sql_compat/test_vendored_sqlglot_bypass.py does not look at scripts/.

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-10-25)
- The scanner scans only `PACKAGE_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / "benchbox"` (`scan_package`, `scan_fork_rewrite_imports` use `package_root.rglob`) with ALLOWED_PATHS = benchbox/_vendor/ and benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py. scripts/ and _project/ are outside it, so the audit's 'confirm whether the scanner covers scripts/' answer is NO.
- The call is not a harmless formatter: the fork's generator applies BenchBox rewrites even for same-dialect output. Executed with the fork: `transpile("SELECT a / b, SUM(x) FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP(a)", read="sqlite", write="sqlite", pretty=True)` returns `CAST(a AS REAL) / b` (exact-division policy), while postgres/netezza/duckdb keep `a / b`. Documentation SQL rendered for SQLite can therefore differ from the rendered query text. generate_query_docs output feeds docs and scripts/export_docs_data.py (site data).
- There is no formatting entry point in benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py (`translate_sql_query` at the time of review is the only translation wrapper; no `pretty`/`format` helper exists).
- Other direct SQLGlot users outside the scanned tree: `_project/scripts/detect_self_binding.py` and `_project/scripts/build_joinorder_data.py` (parse only; the first imports the vendored fork), and `_project/sql-translation-ml/{corpus,evaluate,experiment,oracle,schema_evaluate,schema_generator}.py`, which `import sqlglot` (upstream PyPI) and call `sqlglot.transpile` for ML evaluation; none is shipped. 

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 How docs formatting should work. Options: (a) add a wrapper formatting entry point in dialect_utils.py that parses and generates without BenchBox rewrites (recommended if the fork can do this without rewrite side effects; otherwise (b)); (b) keep the call but allowlist it with a reason, with documented consequence that docs may show rewrite-normalised SQL; (c) drop pretty-printing for dialects whose generator rewrites.
G2 Scanner scope. Options: extend the scanner to scripts/ (recommended, small); extend also to _project/ (decide per script whether it is tooling to allowlist or dead code to remove); leave _project/ out with a recorded reason.
G3 The `_project/sql-translation-ml` scripts use upstream sqlglot, i.e. a different translator from the product: owner decides allowlist-with-reason versus removal.

GUARDRAILS
- Allowlist entries need a disposition from DISPOSITIONS (parse_only / ast_rewrite / pin_identity / availability_guard) plus count/digest and a reason; never loosen detection kinds to pass.
- Do not change benchmark translation behaviour; docs text for platforms other than the changed one must not drift (see acceptance).
- No explanatory comments/docstrings in code.

STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`. Stop and ask the owner on unexpected result changes, relaxed guards, oracle stand-ins or real design choices.
